faqs.q: How do I give my tithe or offering?
faqs.a: Go to the Give tab, choose a fund (Tithe, Offering, Building Fund, or Missions), pick or enter an amount, choose a payment method, then tap Give. Your gift is recorded under Profile → Giving history.
Yes — go to Profile → Settings → Change password, enter your new password twice, and tap Update password.

faqs.q: How do I save a sermon to watch later?
faqs.a: On the Home page, under Recent Sermons, tap the bookmark icon on any sermon thumbnail. Find your saved sermons anytime under Profile → Saved sermons.

faqs.q: Where do my prayer requests go?
faqs.a: Requests submitted under Profile → Prayer requests are sent to our prayer team, who pray over every submission. You can see your own request history on that same page.

Yes. Go to Profile → Settings, scroll to Account actions, and tap Delete my account. This permanently removes your profile, giving history, prayer requests, saved sermons and downloads — it can't be undone.

faqs.q: How do I switch between light and dark mode?
faqs.a: Go to Profile → Settings → Appearance, and choose Dark or Light, plus an accent color. Your choice is saved on this device.
